findings.summary: Headline memory number is unreproducible and may not apply to the mypyc-compiled build users run; speed claim has no timing and some changes (ABC metaclass) may slow isinstance
Body claims changes the diff doesn't make or reverses: used_names still built on every parse; some 'removed allocations' add allocations
Most of the diff is unrelated drive-by refactors and eq=False/repr=False changes that don't touch memory; should be a separate PR
Node.__init__ contract changed (context removed, children not copied, prefix position) while docstring is stale
Leaf prefix handling changed for explicit empty prefix
Several slots do nothing (StringMerger, PgenGrammar, TokenProxy logger) and a dead guard remains

why: Important 3 states the maintainer's reason: a bundle of unrelated small refactors that don't serve the memory claim, to be split out; Important 1 also questions the performance claim under the mypyc build.
